description: Illustrates the duplicate screen_viewed suppression rule described in specification/screen-tracking.md. Each entry is one navigation occurrence; 'emitted' indicates whether a screen_viewed event is recorded for it.

sequence.note: First view of this screen in the session.
A re-render or repeated call for the same, still-current screen is suppressed.
The active screen context changed to a distinct screen.
Returning to a previously-viewed screen is a new occurrence and is recorded again.
